alternatives.intervention: Configure and trial the existing matching rule and exception report.
risks: May not cover every mismatch class

applicability.rationale: A new service was requested before checking whether the existing platform can meet the outcome.

assumptions: The rule covers the observed mismatch classes
The exception report is available to operators
falsifiers: A representative trial leaves more than one hour of weekly work
causalHypothesis.mechanism: The platform performs deterministic matching and emits only exceptions for operator review.
causalHypothesis.statement: Configuring and measuring the existing matching rule may achieve the outcome with less operational burden than a new service.

constraints.statement: Operators must be able to explain unresolved mismatches.

counterfactual.conclusion: A new service is premature; first test the existing platform capability against the operational outcome.
failureConditions: Operators still investigate the same exceptions
The service creates conflicting match decisions
The new service is not adopted
counterfactual.question: If a custom service were delivered, when would the outcome remain unmet?
residualRisks: The existing capability may prove insufficient after trial

costsAndPain: Several hours of manual work each week
currentBaseline.description: The existing platform has an unused matching rule and exception report, while operators reconcile records in a spreadsheet.
noChangeConsequences: Manual work continues unless the existing capability is configured
strengths: Existing platform already owns the source records

desiredOutcomes.statement: Operators spend less than one hour per week reconciling matching records and can explain unresolved mismatches.
successMeasures: Weekly manual effort below one hour

investigationPlan: Run a four-week representative trial and reopen if the threshold is not met
disposition.rationale: The lower-cost existing capability plausibly meets the outcome and avoids duplicate authority.
disposition.selectedDirection: Configure and evaluate the existing platform matching rule before authorizing a custom service.

requestedIntervention.rationale: The service was proposed to reduce manual reconciliation effort.

risk.rationale: A new service would create a competing authority and operational boundary; the trial is low cost.

successEvidence.measure: Operator time and unresolved mismatch explanations during a representative trial
successEvidence.thresholdOrSignal: Less than one hour per week and every unresolved case has an attributable reason
